display.purpose: Page h1 and hero slide headlines; Archivo 800 uppercase, font-stretch 64%.

headline.purpose: Section heads; same narrow 800 uppercase face.

title-narrow.purpose: Zone codes, value names, purposes, timeline years, big figures, the library count.

title.purpose: Sentence-case card, list and publication heads at full width.

quote.purpose: Mission and vision statements, 700 italic at 72% width on the red band.

control.purpose: Buttons, drawer links, news headlines, footer heads; font-stretch 72%.

lead.purpose: One paragraph under a display or section head, Ink Soft, max 46ch.

body.purpose: Running text at full width; 18px in reading sections, 16.5px under 720px.

citation.purpose: Uppercase source line under a scripture quote, with a 2px top rule; never above a heading.

label.purpose: dt labels, captions, metadata; tabular lining figures for numbers.

shadows.name: cover
shadows.purpose: Featured report cover on its Band frame.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: Field focus with the border turning red (0.14 in the library bar).

shadows.name: hero-scrim
shadows.purpose: Carbon scrim keeping white type legible over hero photographs.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default curve for every transform, entrance and slide.

motion.name: color
motion.purpose: Background, border and text color changes; hover only on fine pointers.

motion.name: slide-crossfade
motion.purpose: Hero autoplay with no visible controls; pauses on hover, focus and hidden tab; swipe on touch.

motion.name: slide-settle
motion.purpose: Slow settle of the active hero photograph.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Hero copy entrance; library tiles use 420ms.

motion.name: rule-slide
motion.purpose: Segmented thumb in the library filter (240ms) and zone-tab rule (260ms).

motion.name: nav-underline
motion.purpose: 4px red marker under nav and sub-nav links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: durations 1ms; no hero autoplay, no settle; slide fades 400ms

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Caritas red block: donate, give, primary actions.
components.html: Faire un don
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid #7c0800; border-radius: 0; background: #7c0800; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 750; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn svg { transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-red:hover { background: #650600; border-color: #650600; } .ds-btn:hover svg { transform: translateX(3px); } .ds-btn-red:active { background: #540500; border-color: #540500; transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Line Button
components.description: Ink-outlined secondary action on light ground.
components.css: .ds-btn-line { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid #161412; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #161412; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 750; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-line:hover { background: #161412; color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-line:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-line:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: White-outlined secondary over photographs and red bands.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; border: 2px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: #ffffff; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 72%; font-weight: 750; font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #ffffff; border-color: #ffffff; color: #161412; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffffff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Link Arrow
components.description: Text link with a 2px red underline and red arrow; gap widens on hover.
components.html: Qui sommes-nous
components.css: .ds-link-arrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 3px; border-bottom: 2px solid #7c0800; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #161412; text-decoration: none; transition: color 160ms ease, gap 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-link-arrow svg { color: #7c0800; } .ds-link-arrow:hover { color: #7c0800; gap: 12px; } .ds-link-arrow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Band track with a square carbon thumb behind the checked option; the library type filter.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px; background: #f2f0ed; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-seg input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-seg label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 650; color: #45403a; cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms ease, background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-seg input:checked + label { background: #161412; color: #ffffff; } .ds-seg input:focus-visible + label { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square field with a 1.5px Line Strong stroke; focus turns red with a halo.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 46px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1.5px solid #cbc4bb; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #161412; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; transition: border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #69635c; } .ds-input:focus, .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #7c0800; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(124 8 0 / 0.14); }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: White 80px header links with a 4px red rule scaling in from the left.
components.html: Qui sommes-nousNotre actionNotre réseauRessourcesActualités
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 80px; align-items: stretch; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e1db; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 14px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 650; color: #161412; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 14px; right: 14px; bottom: -1px; height: 4px; background: #7c0800; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page']::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: -3px; }

components.name: Zone Tabs
components.description: Signature: narrow uppercase zone codes over a baseline, 4px red rule under the selected tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-bottom: 2px solid #cbc4bb; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs button { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; padding: 0 10px 16px 0; margin-bottom: -2px; border: 0; border-bottom: 4px solid transparent; background: none; text-align: left; color: #69635c; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms ease, border-color 260ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1); } .ds-tabs strong { font-stretch: 64%; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; text-transform: uppercase; color: #45403a; transition: color 160ms ease; } .ds-tabs span { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] { color: #161412; border-bottom-color: #7c0800; } .ds-tabs button[aria-selected='true'] strong { color: #7c0800; } .ds-tabs button:hover strong { color: #161412; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7c0800; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
Caritas Africa speaks here the way the largest international NGOs speak: a documentary photograph owns the first screen, the headline is a campaign line set heavy, condensed and uppercase, and giving is one red button away in the header, the hero and a full-width red giving band. The voice is loud where it should be (hero, section heads, the red bands) and quiet everywhere else: normal-width Archivo for reading, hairlines and heavy ink rules for data, every photograph credited on a dark tab.

One family carries everything. Archivo's width axis does the work a second typeface would do: narrow (64%) for display and section heads, condensed (72%) for buttons, quotes and small heads, full width (100%) for text and UI. Caritas red is not a sparing accent but a committed field: the primary action, the mission band and the giving band. Carbon frames the page at top (utility bar) and bottom (footer) and backs the hero; one warm grey band alternates with white.

Geometry is square without exception, except for the circular WhatsApp button. Depth is nearly absent; shadows mark the things that sit above the page (menus and toasts, the floating WhatsApp button) and the printed report cover. Faith is stated plainly, as scripture citations under the mission and vision quotes, never as ornament.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed, credited documentary photographs under a carbon scrim; never rounded.
Archivo variable for everything: 800 uppercase at 64% width for display and heads, 72% width for controls, 100% for text.
Caritas red as a committed field (primary action, mission and giving bands) and as the 4px "you are here" rule.
4px ink rules over every data group, 1px hairlines between rows and cells; no cards.
Square corners everywhere; the WhatsApp button is the one circle.
One motion grammar: ease-out cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), 0.97 press at 160ms, hover only on fine pointers.

rules.name: The Committed Red Rule
rules.body: Red is a field, not a spark: it may fill a whole band (mission, giving) or the primary action, and it marks "you are here" (current nav item, selected zone tab). It never decorates (no red tints as section grounds, no red icons in cards for their own sake).

rules.name: The Three Grounds Rule
rules.body: Sections sit on white, Band or a full-width colored field (carbon or red). Surfaces change by whole-width bands, never by floating tinted boxes.

rules.name: The Width-Is-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Rank is set by width before size: 64% width 800 uppercase for anything that heads, 72% for anything you press, 100% for anything you read. Never set running text condensed, never set a heading at full width.

rules.name: The Citation-Below Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase text appears only as a citation under the quote it sources. There are no labels above headings: the heading speaks first.

rules.name: The Ruled Data Rule
rules.body: Lists and data are ruled rows: a 4px Ink rule over the group, 1px Line between rows, vertical hairlines between cells. Never cards.

rules.name: The Sits-Above Rule
rules.body: Only overlays, the floating button and the printed cover cast shadows. Sections, tiles, lists and panels stay flat.

dos: Do let a credited documentary photograph own the first screen, with a carbon scrim only as strong as legibility needs.
Do set every heading in Archivo 800 uppercase at 64% width, every control at 72% width, and all reading text at 100%.
Do use Caritas red as a committed field: primary action, mission and giving bands, and the 4px current-state rule.
Do build data as ruled rows and cells: 4px Ink over the group, 1px Line between rows, vertical hairlines between cells.
Do keep every corner square; the WhatsApp button is the only circle.
Do put the scripture or statute citation under its quote, never a label above a heading.
Do use the ease-out curve (cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), 0.97 presses at 160ms, hover only on fine pointers, and fall back to plain fades under reduced motion.
Do keep "Faire un don" and "Signaler un abus" reachable from every page's header or utility bar.
donts: Don't put small uppercase eyebrow labels or kickers above headings.
Don't put content in shadowed or tinted cards; shadows belong to overlays, the floating button and the printed cover.
Don't round photographs, buttons or fields, or use pill shapes.
Don't introduce a second accent color; WhatsApp green stays on the WhatsApp button.
Don't use gradients except as carbon scrims over photographs.
Don't use religious ornament (crosses, halos, stained glass) as decoration; the logo is the only emblem.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons; use the 1.75-stroke line set.
Don't set running text condensed or headings at full width.
